tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Find Mekler paid operations for a task, including exclusions and useful combinations.

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Get a complete public service or operation contract by slug, operation ID, name, or endpoint URL.

tools.name: scan_origin

tools.name: get_scan_status
tools.description: Read a conformance job state with job_id and recovery_capability. Polling never starts work or settles payment.

tools.name: get_scan_report
tools.description: Read a completed public cached report by report_id. Reports expire after 24 hours; this tool never purchases a replacement.

tools.name: list_conformance_checks
tools.description: Read the versioned 25-check linter and separate 14-check compliance catalogs, grading rules and unknown-evidence semantics.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Find x402 services imported from attributed catalogs or scanned by Mekler. Filter by task text, host, category, network, source, tier, grade or owner control. Unknown grades, prices and health remain unknown. Payment-ready means a recent valid unsigned challenge; it does not certify useful paid deli

tools.name: retrieve_listing
tools.description: Read one visible directory listing, attributed source assertions, measured reachability, endpoint offers and available linter grades. Imports start ungraded; identity-reviewed business wording does not verify seller claims or paid delivery. Never signs payments.

tools.name: export_listings
tools.description: Export up to 10000 visible x402 directory services with attributed source facts, measured health and grade history, first seen, scan counts, provenance and explicit truncation. Returns gzip+base64 JSON and a digest; large results use a 60 second signed download URL. Costs 0.25 USDC on Base or Solana

tools.name: list_grade_changes
tools.description: Read ordered new, grade_changed and rescanned events with previous grades and scores. Default 200, maximum 1000; signed watermark cursors. tools.description: Start a one-hour domain challenge bound to your private random 32-byte requester key in lowercase hex. Publish the returned JSON exactly at its HTTPS well-known URL. Keep the requester key private. An imported directory listing or completed scan is required before confirmation. No payment or target

tools.description: Confirm a one-hour domain challenge with the same private requester key. Exact HTTPS origin and path must match. tools.name: update_listing_preferences
tools.description: Use X-Mekler-Listing-Control and the expected revision to hide a listing, suppress branding or revoke access. Domain proof is rechecked after seven days; failed, stale, revoked or expired credentials deny control. Concurrent writes return 409. Suppression affects current reads, new exports/feed page

tools.name: request_listing_update
tools.description: Request a free reviewed listing correction with X-Mekler-Listing-Control, current revision, a fresh private requester_key and exact changes. Reuse that same requester_key and identical body after an uncertain response; it pins one request, and changed input conflicts. A verified private email is req

tools.name: reissue_owner_token
tools.description: Request one email-based ownership-credential replacement for an existing verified private contact. POST origin for a uniform 202 response whether eligible or not. POST the same origin and recovery_code to confirm within 15 minutes. Domain control and original ownership scope are checked; success rep

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Read categories present in visible identity-reviewed directory listings. Never signs payments.

tools.name: list_networks
tools.description: Read canonical network identifiers in visible directory routes. Imported network claims are attributed and unverified until observed. Never signs payments.

tools.name: list_offer_changes
tools.description: Read changes observed in unsigned payment challenges. Before/after fingerprints preserve payout privacy. A drained cursor advances to new observations on later polls; retain it. No paid delivery is inferred. Never signs payments.

tools.name: retrieve_listing_history
tools.description: Page through Mekler uptime, latency or observed price history for one listing. Raw history retains 30 days; UTC daily aggregates are retained indefinitely. Unknown input/auth/rate-limit observations are excluded from uptime denominators. This is configuration/reachability evidence, not paid-delivery

tools.name: retrieve_health_checks
tools.description: Page through fixed safe monitoring observations for one listing or the whole visible catalog. Current hiding and attribution controls apply to retained history. No captured target body, contact or payout address is returned. Never signs payments.

tools.name: summarize_directory_status
tools.description: Read measured online, degraded, offline and unknown states, delisted count and latest completed monitoring cycle. Missing checks remain unknown; this does not certify paid delivery. Never signs payments.

tools.name: get_trial_offer
tools.description: Read the adjustable free-use offer, wallet authentication, allowance and explicit paid transition.

tools.name: get_trial_access
tools.description: Get the service request and standard wallet-auth instructions. First signed execution enrolls automatically; no wallet funds or payment required.

tools.name: rotate_trial
tools.description: Write: request a wallet-rotation challenge with old_wallet/new_wallet/request_id; then submit old_proof/new_proof signed with both keys. Usage is preserved.

tools.name: referral_accept_terms
tools.description: Accept a newer version of the referral terms to keep earning. arguments: terms_version and terms_digest from referral_program. Call without proof to get a SIWx challenge, sign it with the referrer wallet, then call again with proof. No payment is authorized.

tools.name: referral_acknowledge
tools.description: Mark notices already served by referral_notices as read up to a cursor. arguments: cursor (integer) and optional private_cursor. Call without proof to get a SIWx challenge, sign it with the referrer wallet, then call again with proof. No payment is authorized.

tools.name: referral_notices
tools.description: Read published program notices and the referrer's private account events. arguments: optional cursor, limit (1-50) and private_cursor. Call without proof to get a SIWx challenge, sign it with the referrer wallet, then call again with proof. No payment is authorized.

tools.name: referral_receipts
tools.description: Page through a referrer's commission receipts, oldest first. arguments: optional cursor (last seen) and limit (1-50). Call without proof to get a SIWx challenge, sign it with the referrer wallet, then call again with proof. No payment is authorized.

tools.name: referral_register
tools.description: Register a wallet as a Mekler referrer and receive a referral code. arguments: terms_version and terms_digest from referral_program, which explicitly accept those exact terms. Call without proof to get a SIWx challenge, sign it with the referrer wallet, then call again with proof. No payment is auth

tools.name: referral_rotate
tools.description: Move a referral registration to a new wallet without losing history. arguments: old_wallet and new_wallet; then send proof (old wallet) and new_proof (new wallet). Call without proof to get a SIWx challenge, sign it with the referrer wallet, then call again with proof. No payment is authorized.

tools.name: referral_status
tools.description: Read a registered referrer's code, referral link, accepted versus current terms and whether action is required. arguments: none. Call without proof to get a SIWx challenge, sign it with the referrer wallet, then call again with proof. No payment is authorized.

tools.name: referral_program
tools.description: Read current Mekler referral availability, terms and commission offer.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_service, update_listing_preferences, request_listing_update · Private data: start_ownership_proof, confirm_ownership_proof, update_listing_preferences, request_listing_update, reissue_owner_token, retrieve_health_checks, get_trial_offer, get_trial_access, rotate_trial, referral_accept_terms, referral_acknowledge, referral_notices, referral_receipts, referral_register, referral_rotate, referral_status · Public sink: start_ownership_proof, request_listing_update, reissue_owner_token, rotate_trial, referral_rotate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_service, update_listing_preferences, request_listing_update · Private data: start_ownership_proof, confirm_ownership_proof, update_listing_preferences, request_listing_update, reissue_owner_token, retrieve_health_checks, get_trial_offer, get_trial_access, rotate_trial, referral_accept_terms, referral_acknowledge, referral_notices, referral_receipts, referral_register, referral_rotate, referral_status · Public sink: start_ownership_proof, request_listing_update, reissue_owner_token, rotate_trial, referral_rotate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

remediation.title: Tool description changed since last scan
remediation.detail: Tool "referral_register" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
